landing.heroTitle: Every child can learn — with the right support.
landing.heroBody: AbleSprout is an AI-powered Inclusive Education OS for Indian schools. It helps special educators assess, plan IEPs, adapt worksheets and keep families in the loop — in English and Hindi.
landing.heroStat1: IEP drafts in minutes, not evenings
landing.problemTitle: Inclusion is hard to run on paper
landing.problem1Body: IEPs, observation notes and adapted worksheets are written by hand, again and again, after school hours.
landing.problem2Body: Families rarely see goals or progress, and home practice is disconnected from what happens in class.
landing.problem3Body: Leaders can't see which learners have plans, which reviews are due, or where support is working.
landing.modulesBody: Everything a special educator needs, connected around the learner.
landing.m1Body: Screenings, observations and 1–5 skill ratings across eight domains.
landing.m2Body: SMART goals, accommodations and interventions drafted for you to edit and approve.
landing.m3Body: Generate or adapt worksheets with dyslexia-friendly fonts, large print and chunked steps.
landing.m4Body: Log progress in seconds and see every goal's trend at a glance.
landing.m5Body: A simple, respectful thread with families — share home activities in one tap.
landing.m6Body: School-wide view of needs, IEP coverage, reviews due and educator activity.
landing.audienceTitle: Built for everyone around the learner
landing.indiaBody: Aligned with NEP 2020's inclusive, competency-based learning, the RPwD Act 2016's reasonable accommodation, and the DPDP Act 2023's data protection — student names are never sent to AI.
landing.privacyBody: Every school's data is isolated, every change is audit-logged, and AI only ever sees “the student”.
landing.pilotBody: We're partnering with a small number of schools to shape AbleSprout. Tell us about yours.
landing.pilotMessage: What support do your learners need?
landing.pilotThanks: Thank you! We'll be in touch within a few days.
